discourse.title: Give up Dehabhimana, Develop Atmabhimana
discourse.excerpt: Respect one and all, for, the divine Atma, is present in all. To respect all is true worship. If you want to be respected, you should respect others in the first instance. Give respect and take respect. Understand the principle of oneness that is Divinity.
discourse.theme: Love and respect all — the same Atma dwells in everyone.

reflection: Have you ever said something sweet while your heart was somewhere else? Swami asks you to notice that gap — because He says you can only be called a human being when your thoughts, words and deeds are in total harmony. The good news? It works in reverse too: one sincere act of love today — a genuine compliment, a patient ear — and watch the world reflect it back. Give respect, and respect finds you.

video.title: Jesus taught to Love All, Serve All | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Dec 25, 2001

seva_nudge: Turn one sweet word into action today: help one person practically — carry a bag, make a call, share a meal.
